title: The root-count conjecture for $p_k$
statement:
Let $p_k(x)$ be the polynomial defined in the surrounding argument for an integer $k\geq2$.
**Root-count conjecture for $p_k$.** The polynomial $p_k(x)$ has at most two real roots in $(0,1)$, counting multiplicity.
The preceding lemma only establishes a leading-coefficient and sign property and does not prove this stronger root-count assertion. No resolution is given in the supplied text.
references:
Source: https://arxiv.org/abs/2302.12276

Status: **solved** according to the source (as of February 2023). “As mentioned earlier, this was proved shortly after by several researchers.”
source_name: Raphael Yuster, “Almost k-union closed set systems”, arXiv:2302.12276 (2023).
